string.text: {=taom_enlist_already_serving}You are bound to military service.
{=taom_enlist_discharge}I ask to be released from your service.
{=taom_enlist_discharge_answer}You have marched well enough. Go, then — you are released.
{=taom_enlist_menu_leave}Ask to be released from service
{=taom_enlist_menu_status}Review your service
{=taom_enlist_merit_toast}The sergeants noted your conduct: {GRADE}.
{=taom_enlist_oath_ask}Then swear it: your blade at my side, my bread in your pack, until your term is served. Do you swear?
{=taom_enlist_oath_decline}On second thought — not yet.
{=taom_enlist_oath_swear}I swear it.
{=taom_enlist_offer}I wish to enlist under your command.
{=taom_enlist_promoted}You have been promoted to {RANK}.
{=taom_enlist_qm_issued}See the quartermaster's wagon — your kit is in your baggage.
{=taom_enlist_qm_refused}You have drawn your due for your rank already. Earn the next stripe first.
{=taom_enlist_qm_request}I would draw my service kit from the quartermaster.
{=taom_enlist_reassign}I would take a different place in the line.
{=taom_enlist_reassign_arc}I shoot better than I stab.
{=taom_enlist_reassign_cav}I can ride. Give me a horse.
{=taom_enlist_reassign_done}Report to your new section, then. Don't make me regret it.
{=taom_enlist_reassign_inf}Put me in the shield line.
{=taom_enlist_reassign_sup}The baggage and the wounded need hands.
{=taom_enlist_status_body}Commander: {COMMANDER}. Enlisted on day {ENLISTED_DAY}; contract ends on day {CONTRACT_END}.
{=taom_enlist_status_title}Service record
{=taom_enlist_term_served}Your term of service is complete — you may ask for release with honor, or march on.
{=taom_enlist_wait_text}You serve in {COMMANDER}'s company. The column moves at your commander's pace.
{=taom_enlist_welcome}Welcome to the column, soldier. Fall in.
{=taom_fc_decline}Not Yet
{=taom_fc_keep_name}Keep Default Name
{=taom_fc_no_room_body}There is no room for another companion right now. {TROOP_NAME}'s promotion will be offered again later.
{=taom_fc_offer_body}{TROOP_NAME} has distinguished themselves in battle. Promote them to a companion?
{=taom_fc_offer_title}Battlefield Promotion
{=taom_fc_rename_body}Give {TROOP_NAME} a name, or keep the one they carried into battle.
{=taom_fc_rename_title}Name the New Companion
{=taom_enlist_act_battle}{COMMANDER} is engaged. Hold your place in the line.
{=taom_enlist_act_lost}You have lost the column. Await word of your commander.
{=taom_enlist_act_march}You march with {COMMANDER}'s company, at your commander's pace.
{=taom_enlist_act_settlement}The column rests inside {SETTLEMENT}.
{=taom_enlist_act_siege}You are camped before the walls with {COMMANDER}'s company.
{=taom_enlist_board_arrears}{NEWLINE}Pay owed to you: {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON}
{=taom_enlist_board_duty}{NEWLINE}You have orders: {DUTY_NAME}
{=taom_enlist_duty_already}You already have your orders. See them done first.
{=taom_enlist_duty_none}Nothing for you at present. Stay sharp — that changes.
{=taom_enlist_menu_duty}Ask your sergeant for work
{=taom_enlist_menu_talk}Speak with your commander
{=taom_enlist_reassign_pick}You march with the {CURRENT_SECTION} at present. Where would you rather stand?
{=taom_enlist_release_battle}Not while there is fighting to be done. Ask me again when the field is quiet.
{=taom_enlist_release_desert}Then I am done with your company. I take my leave, oath or no.
{=taom_enlist_release_desert_answer}Then you are an oathbreaker, and every man here knows it. Get out of my sight.
{=taom_enlist_release_desert_option}Desert the company
{=taom_enlist_release_in_battle}There is fighting to be done. Ask again once the field is quiet.

{=taom_enlist_release_refused_body}Your commander holds you to your oath — {DAYS} more days are owed. Leaving now is desertion: you forfeit the pay still owed to you, and your commander will not forget it.
{=taom_enlist_release_refused_title}Your term is not served
{=taom_enlist_release_relent}As you say. I will hold the line.
{=taom_enlist_release_soon}You swore to serve, and {DAYS} days of that oath are still owed. I hold you to it.
{=taom_enlist_release_stay}Stay and serve
{=taom_enlist_section_inf}shield line
{=taom_enlist_section_sup}baggage train
{=taom_enlist_trust_poor}in poor odour
{=taom_enlist_trust_solid}well regarded
{=taom_enlist_wait_board}{ACTIVITY}{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Rank: {RANK} · {SECTION}{NEWLINE}Days served: {DAYS} · Standing: {TRUST}{ARREARS}{DUTY}
{=taom_enlist_grade_rough}rough, but you held
